name: Apple Magic Mouse (1st Generation / AA Battery Powered)
description: Experience the classic that started it all! This genuine 1st Generation Apple Magic Mouse (Model A1296) brings Apple's iconic minimalist design right to your desktop. Unlike the newer version, this 1st Gen treasure is powered by 2 standard AA batteries, meaning you never have to plug it in upside down and wait to charge—just pop in fresh batteries and you are instantly back to work! Features a seamless Multi-Touch top surface that supports intuitive multi-directional scrolling and fluid macOS gestures. Fully tested, pairs flawlessly via Bluetooth with Macs or iPads, and tracks smoothly with its precision laser sensor!
contact_note: Requires 2 AA batteries (not included). The aluminum bottom cover plate is present and locks securely. Fully tested, sanitized, and ready to pair. Porch pickup ready!
meta_description: Pre-owned genuine 1st Gen Apple Magic Mouse (Model A1296) in good condition. Laser tracking sensor, multi-touch gesture surface, powered by 2 AA batteries.
name_zh: 苹果 Apple Magic Mouse 妙控无线蓝牙鼠标 1代 (电池版/A1296)
